column5: Wood pulp and Portland cement board, cut from nominal 8.5 mm stock. Exact cement formulation, fiber fraction, manufacturer, cure age and porosity are unspecified. The source metadata headline density is 1290 kg/m3; the reported Wet HFM density inputs instead average 1332.6666666666667 kg/m3. They are not silently reconciled. Stock thickness identifies the source product population, not an intrinsic property or the test thickness. Capacity and conductivity use distinct experiments in the same source population; exact same-coupon correspondence is not established. No structural, acoustic, fire, dehydration, melting or service-temperature qualification follows.

Wet in the filenames means unconditioned indoor storage at 22 +/- 3 degC and relative humidity 40 +/- 20 percent, not water saturation or oven drying. Actual moisture content and applied contact pressure are unspecified. HFM samples are planar. Conductivity generally follows ASTM C518 through thickness with upward heat flow. Capacity generally follows ASTM C1784-20 equal-plate temperature steps. Finite differences and test direction remain part of the source conditions. Calibration uncertainty and cross-property covariance are unknown.
